transaction_boundary: Separate files, connections and transactions; never ATTACH or hold a coordination write transaction across Operation invocation.

version_compatibility.read_rule: Require exact user_version, metadata schema version, frozen R01 product digest, schema digest and expected resource ID before mutable use. Reject an unexpected peer database, alias path or shared resource.
version_compatibility.new_database: Explicit initialization of fresh empty files only; schema SQL is an initialization prototype, never a migration runner.
version_compatibility.existing_database: Read-only preflight first. Do not run schema SQL or overwrite user_version/metadata on reopen. Unknown, older, newer or missing metadata is a typed mismatch.
version_compatibility.upgrade: No automatic migration. A successor candidate must separately define conversion and test old-state preservation.
version_compatibility.boot_rule: Coordination boot identity must match the live boot; compare shared monotonic milliseconds and persisted high-water mark. Reject clock regression or boot mismatch without inventing terminal state.
version_compatibility.metadata_profile_digest_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, separators comma/colon, no trailing newline

operation_contract.recognize: Read matching identity and binding/payload digest; return recorded success, absent, or typed unknown. Absence does not prove a previously executing stale worker can never commit.
operation_contract.apply_or_recognize: Inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE reread the result. Return matching success or validate payload and apply example row plus success ledger plus Operation outbox atomically. Error before commit rolls back all three; unknown commit requires reread. Do not record a success on failure.
operation_contract.result_digest: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 result JSON; exact canonicalization and identity algorithm are carried unchanged from the selected reference implementation or explicitly pinned in R03/R04.
operation_contract.terminal_unknown_limit: Exhausted/unresolved is not a proof of zero business effects: a stale in-flight local Operation can still commit. Its stable identity prevents duplicate application.

command_contracts.allowlist: Command.kind must be one of these values; R03 rejects unknown kinds and validates the exact payload per command. Contracts.py is a typed seam, not an implemented decoder.
command_contracts.outbox: Each state transition writes one unique transition ID and one dispatch event in its local transaction. Delivery marking is a projection update and cannot advance dispatch state. Duplicate delivery uses the same event ID.
command_contracts.unknown_commit: Lookup transition_id and command_digest on a new connection; exact prior commit returns recorded version, differing command rejects, absence permits a new state read, inaccessible evidence remains unknown.

failure_mapping.effect: No new execution start; later polling rereads state. No implicit Operation retry.

failure_mapping.provider: commit response lost or I/O with uncertain commit
failure_mapping.effect: Reopen and reconcile stable transition/result identities; stop on unreadable evidence.

failure_mapping.provider: identity, binding, schema, boot or payload mismatch
failure_mapping.effect: Reject mutable use; preserve diagnostic evidence without fabricating a terminal.
